contracts.commit_point: The LangGraph tool-execution step for the gated tool names: the middleware interrupts before the tool runs (no tool result and no final assistant answer is produced while pending; BankAgentRunner returns hitl_pending=True), and the MCP tool call commits only after the graph is resumed with the approve Command; a reject Command resumes the graph with a rejection message instead of executing the tool.
contracts.declared_mechanism: HumanInTheLoopMiddleware(interrupt_on=..., description_prefix='Требуется подтверждение операции') appended to middleware and passed to create_agent; interrupt_on keys come from _HITL_INTERRUPT_TOOL_SPECS (open_credit_card, open_deposit; allowed_decisions ['approve','reject']) filtered to names actually present in mcp_tool_names from get_tools(); __interrupt__ chunks mark the turn hitl_pending=True and register the thread in _hitl_waiting_threads; resume occurs only through build_hitl_resume_command(approve) producing Command(resume={'decisions':[{'type':'approve'}]} | {'type':'reject','message':...}) sent from the hitl_bank_operation_callback or the plain-text handler, with hitl_is_waiting enforcing one-shot decisions ('Решение уже учтено' otherwise).
contracts.forbidden_condition: Execution of the open_credit_card or open_deposit MCP tool — and the mock credit-card issuance / mock deposit issuance it triggers on the mcp-bank-agent server — without a recorded human decision restricted to allowed_decisions ['approve','reject']; equivalently, resuming an interrupted turn with an absent or non-conforming decision.

contracts.protected_operation: Agent invocation of the MCP bank tools open_credit_card and open_deposit.
contracts.protected_resource: The open_credit_card and open_deposit tools of the FastMCP server 'mcp-bank-agent' (served over streamable-http) as bound into the LangGraph agent tool list via MultiServerMCPClient.get_tools().
contracts.protection_obligation: MCP bank tool calls open_credit_card and open_deposit must not execute in the agent graph without an explicit human approve/reject decision: HumanInTheLoopMiddleware is registered in create_agent for exactly these tool names, the graph pauses at the tool-call commit point with a LangGraph __interrupt__, and the turn resumes only when BankAgentRunner.ainvoke_turn is re-invoked with a Command(resume={'decisions':[{'type':'approve'|'reject'}]}) produced from the user's Telegram Accept/Reject inline-keyboard press or a recognized text reply (ДА/подтверждаю/yes/ок/approve vs НЕТ/отмена/no/reject).
scope_limits: Guard registration is conditional: interrupt_on includes only spec names present in the names returned by MultiServerMCPClient.get_tools(); if MCP bank is disabled, unreachable, or serves different tool names, no middleware is appended and no HITL gate exists.
Only open_credit_card and open_deposit are gated; sibling MCP tools search_products, loan_payment_mcp, and currency_converter_mcp are registered without HITL.
Allowed decisions are limited to approve/reject; no edit-and-resubmit or other decision types are configured.
The one-shot decision gate hitl_is_waiting is an in-process set (_hitl_waiting_threads) keyed by the stringified chat_id; it does not persist across restarts and is not shared across processes.
Inline-button decisions in private chats are restricted to the chat owner; the supplied text-reply resume path parses decision tokens without an equivalent identity check.
Resume turns remain subject to the agent invocation rate limiter in both handlers.
Server-side handlers are documented demo mocks that do not call real banking systems; the internal effect of issue_mock_credit_card/issue_mock_deposit lies outside the supplied views.
